training.authority: Browser finish request contains only id and content; the UI reloads getById after finish. Both actual UI result panels match persisted correct/error/time/speed values; the existing UI displays integer percentages (66 for stored66.67).
training.trailing_space: Browser input deliberately ended in a space. Java PostEnteringExerciseService:211-212 uses split(" ", -1), preserving an extra empty word; Rust correctly returns3 correct/1 error/75%. No score semantics were changed.

websocket.assertion: Actual UI Ws client authenticated, sent __nip_heartbeat_ping__, received __nip_heartbeat_pong__; browser reload reconnected and real logout closed its socket and removed the token.
websocket.not_proven: Not all room/stateful group-training WS UI flows or hardware behaviors.

regression.after: Rebuilt packaged Electron and separate native Chrome both opened the editor against zero category rows, completed real multipart upload and rendering, and reported zero JavaScript errors.

limitations: Local Linux client workflow proof only; no production cutover, installer/signing acceptance or remote GitHub Actions result.
No real serial/keying device, audio perception, physical customer workstation or all-training-domain UI acceptance.

Default cover/icon resources are absent from the synthetic file-service fixture; their404s were observed, not silently replaced. This round does not prove the complete customer file resource bundle or download workflows.

Managed viewport-emulated Chromium produced an iframe addEventListener Illegal invocation specific to that setup. It was reported to tool QA; the same built app passed in separately launched native Chrome over CDP, without changing TinyMCE.
Existing build warnings (large chunks/deep selectors/module-script notices), Node module/lifecycle warnings and Python socket ResourceWarning remain recorded, not suppressed.
